title: AI agents now attack bank payment APIs
takeaways: Six hours: deadline to report incidents to CERT-In and RBI.
₹48,021 crore: bank fraud amount in FY26, up 46%.
₹56,087 crore reported in cyber fraud complaints, FY24 to FY26.
Only 37% of Indian organisations in IBM's study had AI access controls.
₹220 million: average Indian data breach cost in 2025.
source_note: Sources: I4C via India TV, PSU Watch; RBI via Outlook Business; IBM 2025
